title: English Vocabulary · การเจรจาและการประชุม

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The legislature voted to ratify the convention.”, what does “ratify” mean?
questions.answer: give formal consent to be bound
options: give formal consent to be bound
questions.explanation: Here, “ratify” means to give formal consent to be bound.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The chair tabled the motion for discussion that afternoon.”, what does “table” mean?
questions.answer: formally bring forward for discussion in this context
options: formally bring forward for discussion in this context
questions.explanation: Here, “table” means to formally bring forward for discussion in this context.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The panel voted to defer its decision for a week.”, what does “defer” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “defer” means to postpone until later.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The team tried to reconcile two different totals.”, what does “reconcile” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “reconcile” means to bring into agreement.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The new directive will supersede the earlier circular.”, what does “supersede” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “supersede” means to replace in authority or effect.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The liaison officer helped facilitate discussions.”, what does “facilitate” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “facilitate” means to make easier.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The chair will convene the group next week.”, what does “convene” mean?
questions.answer: bring people together for a meeting
options: bring people together for a meeting
questions.explanation: Here, “convene” means to bring people together for a meeting.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The chair may delegate routine approval to a deputy.”, what does “delegate” mean?
questions.answer: assign authority or a task to another person
options: assign authority or a task to another person
make a task impossible to assign
questions.explanation: Here, “delegate” means to assign authority or a task to another person.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The team asked the agency to clarify its instructions.”, what does “clarify” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “clarify” means to make more precise or understandable.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “Firms must comply with the reporting rule.”, what does “comply” mean?
questions.answer: act in accordance with a rule
options: act in accordance with a rule
questions.explanation: Here, “comply” means to act in accordance with a rule.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The authority will designate a new contact point.”, what does “designate” mean?
questions.answer: formally name or select for a role
options: formally name or select for a role
questions.explanation: Here, “designate” means to formally name or select for a role.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The sponsor chose to withdraw the proposal before the vote.”, what does “withdraw” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “withdraw” means to remove from consideration or participation.

questions.explanation: Here, “ratify” means to give formal consent to be bound.

questions.subject: en

questions.explanation: Here, “reconcile” means to bring into agreement.

questions.subject: en

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Choose the word that expresses this meaning: “make easier”. A common form can ___ the processing of paperwork at the border.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: Choose the word that expresses this meaning: “bring people together for a meeting”. The secretariat asked the director to ___ an emergency meeting.
